### 1. Full hSignIntegral and its law context

The previous four diagnostics at line959 were three failures to synthesize the same source measure `μ : Measure (Path j)` in integral_map and the two measurability coercions, followed by failure to infer the untyped `have` declaration. The full hSignIntegral statement fixes its intended source integral under `law j` and target integral under `signLaw s j`, but the old intermediate have did not expose that measure to elaboration at its own declaration.

The complete repaired proof now invokes `integral_map (μ := law j)`, then rewrites the mapped measure using the unchanged complete hSignMap, and takes symmetry. The Greek named argument is the actual binder `μ` of the pinned head, not a guessed Latin alias. With φ(v)=s·v and f=G, the head gives exactly

`integral (map φ (law j)) G = integral (law j) (G ∘ φ)`.

The actual hSignMap identifies the first measure with the iid product of eta(s)=map(z↦s z)rho. Measurability of the scalar map and G supplies the AE and AE-strong measurability arguments under those same measures. Their source and target measurable spaces are both the finite real path measurable space. There is no circular invocation of hSignIntegral in proving hSignMap.

The full law context was read with support, mean, second moment, absolute third moment and energy transfer. For the actual upper/lower uses, s=±1, while the suffix remains under the original rho product. The equation itself is valid for every real s and every measurable G. It does not assume symmetry of rho, a cap property, invertibility of the scalar map or independence of an indicator. The general integral-map equality is valid with its stated measurability premises even when both integrals are totalized; every later use in a budget has its separately established genuine L1 evidence from the unchanged whole proof. No nonintegrable-zero shortcut is added to a payment.

### 2. Full hWReindex and actual dependent suffix length

The source03 failure at 1172 is a no-progress simp after hWReindex's reverse-permutation identity; there is no new displayed unsolved mathematical goal. The repaired proof keeps the same Equiv.sum_comp and Fin/range identity, and directly changes the composed dependent integral to the definitionally equal suffix expression `n-(r.val+1)`. It removes only the unused hv fact and the rejected simp.

The complete proof maps r∈Fin n to the actual `Fin.revPerm r`. The full already pinned Fin.revPerm value is the permutation induced by Fin.rev, whose actual core value is `n-(r+1)`. Thus the whole integrand, its path dimension, and its measure law all depend on the same natural suffix length. There is no change from n−r to n−r−1, no coercion to a wrong fixed-dimensional function, and no new boundary index. The Nat-indexed function supplied to Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range is explicitly `t ↦ integral (law t) (W t)`.

This gives the grid t=0,…,n−1 exactly. The complete surrounding proof enlarges that grid to Icc 0 n using hW0Int and applies the same accepted W grid estimate. W is nonnegative and genuinely L1 at every t; W0 is zero. The inactive zero-length suffix and the last actual rank are covered without an artificial inverse-square-root singularity. The early denominator comparison and beta-rate identity in the surrounding source are unchanged and retain their prior full review. No changed data or new grid-payment assumption is present.

### 3. Full hTailSourceDom and arbitrary cap tail

The source03 failure at 1391 is a no-progress simp in the active branch of a shared-window finite-sum identity. The repaired proof still sums the complete hTailRank inequality, expands omitted, and combines the two omitted sums. Both walls use exactly the same predicate `tau ≤ r ∧ r < kappa`. On the active branch the two expressions are reflexively equal; on the inactive branch the required equality is precisely `0+0=0`, supplied by `zero_add 0` in the displayed orientation. No event, cap, domain or derivative is changed by these two proof terms.

The whole hTailRank context was read again. For tau≤r<kappa, nonnegative actual halfline cap monotonicity compares the arbitrary nu≤kappa with kappa. At or after kappa, nu≤kappa makes both original source terms zero. Before tau both guarded sides are zero. The tail therefore pays exactly the tau..kappa omitted window, with r=tau included and r=kappa inactive/excluded. Nonnegative intervalPositive and intervalAbsolute make the accepted full tailCost dominate the two-wall omitted contribution. There is still no attempt to apply monotonicity to a signed interval term or assume invariance of nu. The unchanged full bad payment later integrates this same L1 tailCost.

### 4. Full hActualPriorDom and explicit wall multiplier

The source03 actual term at1740 incorrectly inferred CK as the multiplier, yielding a valid inequality about CK that did not have the required type. The repaired term explicitly proves `0 ≤ 3*x`, multiplies `sqrt(n/2) ≤ sqrt(energy p.1)` by that coefficient, and normalizes `mul_assoc` to the precise wall expression. With x≥16 the coefficient is nonnegative. The target after expanding witnessLevel and actualWall is exactly `3*x*sqrt(n/2) ≤ 3*(x*sqrt(energy p.1))`. No estimate involving CK is used.

The entire active/inactive prior-hit envelope proof was read again. The accepted actual prior-hit envelope is specialized with the original arbitrary cap and its exact bound, and its local lets are reduced. On the original active event, energy≥n/2 gives the repaired floored-wall comparison; the accepted witness lower bound then implies the APrior witness threshold. The actual strip equivalence and exact head record increment convert the full EnvPrior to the original record increment times its true future profile. The coefficient remains 6. On the original inactive event, the accepted source bound is zero and the unchanged full EnvPrior is nonnegative. This uses the same actual opposite-hit predicate, original prefix length and true suffix energy; no extra prior-hit or weighted-strip premise is introduced.

The surrounding weighted-prefix theorem, theta-range argument, −11x²/5 exponent, polynomial absorption, ordinary fallback for x≤400, whole base/prior/rare/bad L1 payments and final signed assembly are unchanged at exact source03 segments and reuse that complete review. The new explicit 3*x proof term changes none of those constants or dependencies.
